title: Convexity of inverse spectral Green kernels and nondegeneracy of Robin centers in convex domains
summary: Let $Ω\subset\mathbb{R}^N$ be a bounded convex domain, and let $A=-Δ_D$ be the Dirichlet Laplacian. For every $s>0$ with $N>2s$, we prove that the Green-kernel transform $(x,y)\mapsto K_{s,Ω}(x,y)^{-1/(N-2s)}$ extends continuously by zero to the diagonal and is jointly convex on $Ω\timesΩ$. We prove that the regular part extends real analytically across the diagonal and that the associated Robin function is strictly convex and diverges to $+\infty$ at the boundary.
